title: MELODI: Similarity-Identity Decoupling for Lightweight Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2611.31940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For latency-constrained candidate ranking, we propose a similarity-identity decoupling framework that separates target-history compatibility from target-only information. We study two orders for computing pooled similarity, similarity-then-pool and pool-then-similarity, and identify linearity of the similarity operator in its history argument, for each fixed target, as sufficient for their equivalence, justifying the cheaper pool-then-similarity form. We instantiate the framework as multi-head efficient lightweight operator for decoupling identity and similarity (MELODI), whose similarity branch combines target-conditioned multi-head history pooling with a single residual-free cross layer that is linear in its pooled-history input and whose identity branch is problem-dependent. translated_title: MELODI：面向轻量级排序的相似性-身份解耦
translated_abstract: 对于延迟受限的候选排序任务，我们提出了一种相似性-身份解耦框架，将目标-历史兼容性与仅目标信息分离开来。我们研究了计算池化相似度的两种顺序——先相似后池化与先池化后相似，并证明对于每个固定的目标，相似度算子在其历史参数上的线性性是两种顺序等价的充分条件，从而为计算成本更低的先池化后相似形式提供了理论依据。我们将该框架实例化为解耦身份与相似性的多头高效轻量算子（MELODI），其相似性分支将目标条件化的多头历史池化与一个对其池化历史输入呈线性的单一无残差交叉层相结合，而其身份分支则依赖于具体问题设定。在公开基准数据集上，MELODI 达到或超越了所评估的目标感知与目标无关基线。在两个大规模工业数据集上，它的……
tldr: 本文提出相似性-身份解耦框架 MELODI，证明了相似度算子线性条件下“先池化后相似”与“先相似后池化”等价，从而以更高效的轻量级设计在公开及工业数据集上达到或超越现有排序基线。
en_tdlr: MELODI is a similarity-identity decoupling framework for lightweight ranking that proves the equivalence of pool-then-similarity under linearity, achieving parity with or superiority over target-aware baselines on public and industrial datasets.
